description:

NORTH FAMBRIDGE, CHELMSFORD
CIRCA £35,000 + COMPANY BONUS

THE OPPORTUNITY:

Do you have an electrical background and enjoy helping customers understand products and solve technical problems?

Get Recruited is recruiting on behalf of an established engineering business for a Technical Customer Service Advisor to join its small, friendly team. You'll use your electrical knowledge to answer technical enquiries, support customers and keep their orders moving.

This opportunity would suit a Technical Support Advisor or Customer Service Executive with an electrical background who enjoys answering product questions and helping customers. You'll join long-serving colleagues in a business that values health, family and work, with regular team dinners and your birthday off.

THE TECHNICAL CUSTOMER SERVICE ADVISOR ROLE:

You'll combine the product knowledge of a Technical Support Advisor with the customer care and order administration skills of a Customer Service Executive.
- Handle customer enquiries by telephone and email, asking relevant questions to understand their requirements and provide clear, accurate advice.
- Explain electrical product functions and specifications, helping customers understand technical information and how components operate.

- Liaise with technical colleagues and the overseas manufacturing team to resolve complex questions, keeping customers informed throughout.
- Manage enquiries through the shared inbox, maintaining clear records and following outstanding queries through to resolution.
- Process customer orders accurately, checking product references, quantities and requirements before entering them into the order management system.
- Answer questions about availability, order progress and deliveries, coordinating with colleagues to resolve issues.
- Assist with picking and packing orders when required, contributing to the practical running of a small team.
- Adapt to new systems as the business introduces more automated ordering and customer administration processes.

THE PERSON:
- Experience as a Technical Support Advisor, Customer Service Executive or in a similar position supporting customers with electrical or electronic products.
- Alternatively, an electrical engineering background with experience explaining technical information to customers.
- A sound understanding of electrical components and how they function within a circuit.
- Confident reading electrical diagrams and technical datasheets, including supply voltages, relay contacts and connection arrangements.
- Clear communication skills, patience and a methodical approach to investigating customer problems.
- Strong attention to detail when processing orders, recording information and following up enquiries.
- As a Technical Customer Service Advisor, you'll be comfortable balancing technical enquiries, order processing and practical tasks within a small team.
- A relevant technical qualification is desirable, ideally in electrical or electronic engineering.
- Experience with relays, control panels or industrial automation products would be advantageous.

A Technical Support Advisor will bring experience investigating product questions; a Customer Service Executive will need the electrical knowledge to handle those conversations confidently.

If you're a Technical Support Advisor or Customer Service Executive with an electrical background, or an electrical engineering professional with customer support experience, we'd like to hear from you.
